newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sweden's Ericsson signs $495 mln deal in Mexico.
newsitem.headline: Sweden's Ericsson signs $495 mln deal in Mexico.

text.p: Swedish telecommunications group LM AB Ericsson said on Tuesday it had signed a contract in Mexico with Radiomovil DIPSA S.A. de C.C. (Telecel ) worth 3.5 billion crowns ($494.5 million).
"The agreement covers the period from 1997 to 1999 and may reach a value of 3.5 billion crowns," Ericsson said in a statement.
The agreement is to digitalise the network with digital D-AMPS IS-136, the newest version of the most advanced digital wireless standard on the market, and expand the existing AMPS network.
Ericsson said the agreement also included the introduction of the Wireless Intelligent Network (WIN) platform used to expand the functionality in the wireless network.
"This enables Telcel to offer a wide variety of personalised communication services to their subscribers," Ericsson said.
Telcel, supplied by Ericsson since the start of operations in 1990, is the only operator of a nationwide network in Mexico.
